name: personalaiskills
description: Skills for human connection at work and at home, used daily: specific kudos built from real work (PRs, incidents, design docs) for Slack, Lark, Teams or LinkedIn; constructive feedback with a private growth log; double opt-in intros; first-week welcomes; sincere repairs after a tense meeting; and a daily and after-meeting nudge that finds these moments in transcripts and connected tools. Plus thank-you notes, reconnecting, gratitude lists, comfort in hard times, family story keepsakes and group tributes. Fitted to the relationship, culture and language, and sent only when you say yes.
